author: Ozan 2345

title: iCloud Desteği
body:
Uygulamada iCloud desteği yok.
Oldukça kısıtlı kullanım sunuyor.

Kaydettiğiniz, takip ettiğiniz her şey uygulama silindiğinde sıfırlanıyor.
Kazara uygulama silinse tüm kayıtlarınızı kaybedeceksiniz demektir.
Tavsiye etmiyorum.
author: plajgezgini

title: Good app but
body: Its really good app but i need to do something every two weeks. But i think this feature is not supported yet
author: Aligur

title: Need subscription for widget. Really?!
body: Are you kidding me? It’s really good application to use but I’m really angry. I’m using the free version and don’t expect more. It’s enough for me. But it needs damn subscription to show you a widget after 1 week. It really looks ugly now on my Home Screen as a widget and I don’t want to see it like that. A basic widget should be free. Come on! Just bad user experience and I delete the app now until they fix that.
author: Sauce_2k
